observations: White industrial sewing machine with a digital display and control panel.
Machine is mounted on a white metal table with a red foot pedal.
Spool stand with two thread spools is attached to the right side.
The machine appears clean and undamaged in all photos.
No visible signs of heavy use or wear.
No power cord is visible in any photo, suggesting it may be plugged in or not shown.

claims.claim: A barely used emel direct drive industrial sewing machine with no fault or condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show no visible damage or wear, but no proof of functionality or absence of faults. The 'no fault' claim cannot be verified remotely.
Photos show the machine appears clean and undamaged, but 'good as new' is subjective and not verifiable without testing or close-up of internal components.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, running, and stitching fabric.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories (e.g., power cord, foot pedal, or spool stand).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the power cord, foot pedal, and spool stand showing condition and presence.

risks.risk: Machine may have been used in a harsh environment or with incompatible materials, leading to hidden wear or damage.
risks.proof: Close-up of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanisms to check for rust, wear, or damage.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, stitching fabric.
Close-up photos of the power cord, foot pedal, and spool stand.
Close-up of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanisms.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
